description: This file defines the Outbox class and related message classes for managing RPC message sending over Netty in Apache Spark, including message queuing, connection handling, and failure management.

classes.name: OutboxMessage
classes.description: Sealed trait representing messages that can be sent via the Outbox, with methods for sending and failure handling.

classes.name: OneWayOutboxMessage
classes.description: Represents a one-way message to be sent over RPC, with logging on failure.

classes.name: RpcOutboxMessage
classes.description: Represents an RPC message with success and failure callbacks, handling request lifecycle.

classes.name: Outbox
classes.description: Manages a queue of OutboxMessages, handles connection establishment, message sending, and failure recovery.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue and initiates draining if necessary.

methods.name: drainOutbox
methods.description: Processes queued messages, establishing connection if needed, and sends messages.

methods.name: launchConnectTask
methods.description: Starts a connection attempt to the remote address.

methods.name: handleNetworkFailure
methods.description: Handles connection failures, marks the Outbox as stopped, and notifies remaining messages.

methods.name: closeClient
methods.description: Resets the client connection without closing it.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Outbox, cancels ongoing connection attempts, and fails remaining messages.
